'''Tevelor''' was a word in [[Sauvax (language)|Sauvax]] referring to the leader and spokesbeing of a community or [[kuuvan]]. Tevelors commanded the respect of their people, sometimes obtaining better accommodations or ceremonial decorations.

[[Unidentified tevelor|One particular tevelor]] organized his kuuvan to besiege the [[combine-reaper]] ''[[Gevion]]'' once.
